from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        counts = Counter(row)
        if max((n for color, n in counts.items() if color != fill), default=0) > w / 2:
            row_lines.append(r)

    col_candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))
        if max((n for color, n in counts.items() if color != fill), default=0) > h / 2:
            col_candidates.append(c)

    sep = Counter(Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in row_lines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols = [c for c in col_candidates if any(grid[r][c] != sep for r in row_lines)]
    rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(grid[r][c] != sep for c in cols)]

    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rows[0] + 1, rows[-1])
             for c in range(cols[0] + 1, cols[-1])]
    fill = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            row.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def revised_transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    fill=Counter(Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        counts=Counter(row)
        if max((n for color,n in counts.items() if color!=fill),default=0)>w/2: row_lines.append(r)
    col_candidates=[]
    for c in range(w):
        counts=Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))
        if max((n for color,n in counts.items() if color!=fill),default=0)>h/2: col_candidates.append(c)
    sep=Counter(Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in row_lines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_cols=[c for c in col_candidates if any(grid[r][c]!=sep for r in row_lines)]
    marked_rows=[r for r in row_lines if any(grid[r][c]!=sep for c in marked_cols)]
    if not marked_cols or not marked_rows: raise ValueError('no marked lattice')
    cols=[c for c in col_candidates if marked_cols[0]<=c<=marked_cols[-1]]
    rows=[r for r in row_lines if marked_rows[0]<=r<=marked_rows[-1]]
    cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(rows[0]+1,rows[-1]) for c in range(cols[0]+1,cols[-1])]
    fill=Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners=(grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]],grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0]!=sep and all(v==corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        counts = Counter(row)
        if max((n for color, n in counts.items() if color != fill), default=0) > w / 2:
            row_lines.append(r)

    col_candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h))
        if max((n for color, n in counts.items() if color != fill), default=0) > h / 2:
            col_candidates.append(c)

    sep = Counter(Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in row_lines).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols = [c for c in col_candidates if any(grid[r][c] != sep for r in row_lines)]
    rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(grid[r][c] != sep for c in cols)]

    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rows[0] + 1, rows[-1])
             for c in range(cols[0] + 1, cols[-1])]
    fill = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != sep and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
